svg.aria-label: A running session is deleted only if it is not protected, has no client attached, every pane is at a shell prompt and it has been idle long enough; each check it fails keeps it, with the words the dashboard shows. An exited session is deleted once it has been gone long enough, unless protected. A fact that cannot be read keeps a session too.
